title: /mission for Claude Code
claim: Product Hunt: /mission for Claude Code — Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
why_good: Claude Code is an AI-powered tool that allows users to create missions for AI agents, enabling them to automate tasks and manage projects efficiently.
value: Solo founders pay for streamlined project management and task automation that saves them time and effort.
risk: The risk lies in established competitors quickly integrating similar AI capabilities into their existing platforms.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
does: Claude Code is an AI-powered tool that allows users to create missions for AI agents, enabling them to automate tasks and manage projects efficiently.
why_use: Users often find existing tools too complex or lacking in automation, leading to frustration in managing their projects.
gap: Claude Code missions are developer-centric; no consumer product wraps this capability for non-technical users.
counter: Established project management tools dominate the market, and they could easily add AI features to overshadow new entrants.
differentiator: I would focus on creating a user-friendly interface specifically designed for solo founders, simplifying the process of task delegation to AI agents.
hook: Solo founders struggle to effectively delegate tasks and manage projects without a dedicated team.

zh.claim: 独立创始人在没有专门团队的情况下，难以有效委派任务和管理项目。
zh.hook: 独立创始人在没有专门团队的情况下，难以有效委派任务和管理项目。
zh.does: Claude Code 是一个 AI 驱动的工具，允许用户为 AI 代理创建任务，从而高效地自动化任务和管理项目。
zh.why_use: 用户常常发现现有工具过于复杂或缺乏自动化，导致在管理项目时感到沮丧。
zh.gap: 当前解决方案需要显著的技术知识或缺乏直观界面，使其对独立创始人不可及。
zh.counter: 现有的项目管理工具主导市场，它们可以轻松添加 AI 功能，从而掩盖新进入者。
zh.differentiator: 我会专注于创建一个专为独立创始人设计的用户友好界面，简化将任务委派给 AI 代理的过程。
zh.value: 独立创始人为简化项目管理和任务自动化支付费用，从而节省时间和精力。
zh.risk: 风险在于现有竞争者迅速将类似的 AI 能力整合到他们的现有平台中。
zh.why_good: Claude Code 是一个 AI 驱动的工具，允许用户为 AI 代理创建任务，从而高效地自动化任务和管理项目。

consumer_angle: Ordinary users could delegate complex tasks to AI agents via a simple mission interface, but current tooling requires coding knowledge.
pick_reason: Demand is unverified; PH upvotes are attention, not proof of willingness to pay.
